pull.title: KAFKA-21185: bump lz4 to 1.12.0
pull.body:
Follow-up from https://github.com/apache/kafka/pull/23609#pullrequestreview-5347245515

The release notes of lz4 [1.12.0](https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/releases/tag/v1.12.0) mentions possible breaking changes. What I could found out:

- https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/133 and https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/145 concerns changes with LZ4FrameInputStream -> Kafka is not affected as it relies on its own input stream implementation [Lz4BlockInputStream](https://github.com/apache/kafka/blob/trunk/clients/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/common/compress/Lz4BlockInputStream.java)
- https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/pull/126 input tightening for LZ4DecompressorWithLength -> this class is not imported in Kafka
- Additionally verified update with running [Lz4CompressionTest](https://github.com/apache/kafka/blob/trunk/clients/src/test/java/org/apache/kafka/common/compress/Lz4CompressionTest.java), all tests passed

Reviewers: Chia-Ping Tsai <chia7712@gmail.com>

issue.body:
Bump lz4-java from 1.11.2 to 1.11.4 to fix GHSA-gm45-99xc-r7wv,
GHSA-343h-94h5-c4wr and GHSA-mcr4-qmvw-px4g.
https://github.com/yawkat/lz4-java/releases/tag/v1.11.4

Compression level constants are unchanged, so CompressionType needs no
update. 1.12.0 tightens input validation and can be evaluated
separately.

 <s7133700@gmail.com>
